module TopModule(input  clk, input  areset, input  j, input  k, output out);
  reg [1:0] state, nextstate;
  always @(posedge clk)
    if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
    else state <= nextstate;
  always @(j,k,state) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin out=0; if (j) nextstate=2'b01; else nextstate=2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin out=0; if (k) nextstate=2'b10; else nextstate=2'b01; end
      2'b10: begin out=1; if (k) nextstate=2'b10; else nextstate=2'b10; end
      2'b11: begin out=1; if (j) nextstate=2'b01; else nextstate=2'b11; end
    endcase
  end
endmodule

module TopModule(input clk, input areset, input j, input k, output reg out);
  reg [1:0] state, nextstate;
  always @(*) begin
    case (state)
      2'b00: begin out = 1'b0; if (j) nextstate = 2'b01; else nextstate = 2'b00; end
      2'b01: begin out = 1'b1; if (k) nextstate = 2'b10; else nextstate = 2'b01; end
      2'b10: begin out = 1'b0; if (j) nextstate = 2'b01; else nextstate = 2'b10; end
      default: begin out = 1'b0; nextstate = 2'b00; end
    endcase
  end
  always @(posedge clk) if (areset) state <= 2'b00; else state <= nextstate;
endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  j,
    input  k,
    output reg out
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else case (state)
            2'b00: begin out <= 1'b0; if (j) state <= 2'b01; end
            2'b01: begin out <= 1'b1; if (k) state <= 2'b10; else state <= 2'b00; end
            2'b10: begin out <= 1'b1; if (k) state <= 2'b11; else state <= 2'b01; end
            2'b11: begin out <= 1'b0; if (j) state <= 2'b00; else state <= 2'b10; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule
